1.0.0: Initial release: companies, persons, sales, projects and follow-ups (create, get, update, delete, find), list items, current user, New Company, New Person, New Sale, New Project and New Follow-up polling triggers, and Make API Call. OAuth 2.0 through SuperID for SuperOffice CRM Online.
1.1.0: Generic record components for any object, tickets included: Get Record, Find Records, Update Record (standard and custom fields loaded for the chosen object), Record Updated trigger (polling, optional field or status condition), Create Task (assignee, link to a ticket or company) and Create Note.
Tickets (requests), owners and custom fields (user-defined and extra fields) on the generic records.
Private lookups for objects, fields, status values and users.
1.1.1: Ticket statuses in Update Record and Record Updated are the statuses of the tenant (Open, Closed, ...): the dropdown offered other IDs, so picking Closed did not close the ticket, and in Update Record it did not load at all.
Find Records filters by owner in the query, so it also finds matches older than the newest 100 records.
An unassigned ticket has no owner name and a record that was never updated has no updated date, instead of placeholder values.

Date-times are exact whatever the time zone of the SuperOffice tenant or of the server: the components return UTC (ending with Z), and a date-time they are given is stored as the local time of the tenant, which is what SuperOffice shows. Before, a time sent in UTC appeared shifted by the tenant's UTC offset. The time zone is read from SuperOffice; the service config key timeZone (an IANA name such as Europe/Oslo) overrides it.
